desc: An industry first, the ultra-compact TLR-6® weapon light with C4® LED and integrated 640/660 nm red aiming laser features tool-less battery replacement without removal from the weapon or the need to re-sight the laser. The light pro- vides 1 hour of regulated runtime when in dual light/laser mode. Three operating modes Light only / Light & laser / Laser only. Designed to securely attach to the trigger guard on hand guns. Change batteries while mounted on gun, no need to re-sight laser after battery change. Durable, impact-resistant polymer con- struction; IPX4 water-resistant. 1 meter impact resistance tested.
